q: No government-level (Red Cross) reunion of separated families, and no government-level exchange of confirmations on whether relatives are alive, resumes between the two Koreas by June 30, 2027 (resolves no if the Ministry of Unification announces a government-level reunion or exchange of such confirmations)
basis: Baseline forecast assuming the current course holds. Government-level reunions and confirmations require North Korea's consent, and North Korea refuses any contact with the South. Private confirmations arranged through third countries do not count. · From the Korean Peninsula analysis
rs: Announcements by South Korea's Ministry of Unification
